'''Mixed Seeds''' are a random type of seed capable of producing a specific set of crops (listed below). The crop that will grow from a Mixed Seed is decided when it is planted. Mixed Seeds collected in any season always grow to become crops of the season in which they are planted, including those planted in the [[Greenhouse]] and indoors via the [[Garden Pot]]. Mixed Seeds cannot be planted in winter except in the Greenhouse and indoors in garden pots, where they become one of the random crops from any season. Mixed Seeds planted on [[Ginger Island]] are always the same no matter the season.

==Sources==
*Harvesting [[Weeds]] with a [[Scythe]], [[Axes|Axe]], [[Pickaxes|Pickaxe]], [[Hoes|Hoe]], [[Weapons#Sword|Sword]], or [[Crafting#Bombs|bomb]] may drop mixed seeds if no [[Fiber]] drops (9% chance if [[Raccoon Journal]] has been read, otherwise 5%).<ref name="weedchance" />
*[[Hoes|Tilling]] dirt or sand.
*[[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]].
*Sold by [[Krobus]] on [[Days of the Week#Thursday|Thursdays]] for {{Price|30}} each.
*1/5 chance of being sold at the shop at the [[Stardew Valley Fair]] for {{Price|1000|Token}} for 24 seeds.
*[[Wilderness Golem]]s and [[Iridium Golem]]s on the [[Farm Maps#Wildness Farm|Wilderness Farm map]] have a 50% chance of dropping Mixed Seeds, and a 20% chance (after reaching [[Combat]] Level 5) for a second one when slain.
*[[Crayfish]], [[Periwinkle]], or [[Snail]] [[Fish Pond]]s may produce 2-3 Mixed Seeds when the population of the pond reaches 5.
*Whenever the [[Seed Maker]] is used with any crop, there is a 1.99% chance you will get 1-4 Mixed Seeds instead of the crop's seeds.
*3-5 Mixed Seeds may occasionally be found in [[Supply Crate]]s on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]].
*10 Mixed Seeds may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].
*Sold by the [[Desert Festival#Calico Egg Merchant|Calico Egg Merchant]], [[Evelyn]], and [[Jodi]] at the [[Desert Festival]].
*Sold by the [[Giant Stump#Raccoon Wife's Shop|Raccoon's wife]] after completing the fourth request.
*15 from the prize machine in the [[Mayor's Manor]] (50% chance to be the 3rd prize).

==Quests==
Three or five Mixed Seeds may be requested by several fish in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]].

==Trading==
Ten Mixed Seeds can be traded to the [[Giant Stump#Raccoon Wife's Shop|Raccoon's wife]] for 1 [[Raccoon Hat]], after the [[Giant Stump#Raccoon's Requests|third request]] from the Raccoon family is completed.
